description: This file implements a React component for a password input field with validation, show/hide toggle, and validation messaging, as well as associated controller logic for managing password field state in a form. It also includes a visual indicator for whether the password is set.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the password value based on minimum/maximum length, match regex, common password check, and requiredness.

methods.name: readonlyCheckboxProps
methods.description: Provides props for a read-only checkbox indicating whether the password is set.
